body.name: AI Agent template
body.content:
# Epic: [Workstream] - Agent-[Agent Name]

## Agent Overview

- **Workstream**: [Your workstream]  
- **Agent Role**: [What role does this agent play - e.g., Security Analyst, Test Engineer]
- **Specialization**: [What domain expertise does this agent have]


## Agent Capabilities

- **Primary Functions**: [What can this agent do]
- **Model Requirements**: [Which AI models work best for this agent]
- **Tool/MCP Access**: [What tools/MCP servers does this agent need access to]
- **Enterprise Controls**: [What permissions/governance does this agent need]


## Integration Requirements  

- **Used in Flows**: [Which flows will use this agent]
- **Shared with Workstreams**: [Can other workstreams use this agent]
- **Security Requirements**: [Any special security considerations]


## Implementation Plan

- [ ] Agent persona and instructions
- [ ] Model selection and testing
- [ ] Tool/MCP Dependencies and access permissions
- [ ] Integration with flow orchestration
- [ ] Testing with real scenarios

## Links

- [ ] **Parent Epic**: [Link to this main R&D Enablement epic]
- [ ] **Related Flow Epics**: [Link flows that use this agent]
- [ ] **Related Tool/MCP Issues**: [Link individual tool/integration issues]
